condition.narrative: (a) the Borrower, through MINCYT, shall cause Agencia to establish, and thereafter maintain throughout Projectimplementation:(i) a Project Steering Committee (“Steering Committee”) responsible for providing strategic guidance and oversightof the Project, and with composition, functions and responsibilities acceptable to the Bank and as further described in the ProjectOperational Manual; and(ii) Project Selection Committees (“Selection Committees”) responsible for technical coordination andadvise on the selection of Grants and Eligible Beneficiaries under Part 1 of the Project; and with composition, functions andresponsibilities acceptable to the Bank and as further described in the Operational Manual.

(b) no later than one hundred twenty (120) days after the Effective Date, Agencia shall hire and maintain, throughout Projectimplementation, a Technical and Legal Advisory Team (“TLA”), to assist and advise the Agencia in the selection of the Eligible FundManagers and subsequent legal and operational activities, with terms of reference satisfactory to the Bank, as further described inthe Operational Manual and the ESCP.
